name: DCWL Television Championship
epitaph: Defended once in this collection's own record, on 8 June 1997, when its own first-ever DCWL Heavyweight Champion, Tazmanian Crippler, beat back an open challenge from Bon Scott to remain champion.

name: DCWL Unified Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Changed hands on 8 June 1997 when its own champion, Stagg, publicly vacated the belt on-air and handed it to El Juapo ahead of a token, pre-arranged pinfall.
